evals.prompt: Implement a login endpoint in Spring Boot. POST /api/v1/auth/login that takes email and password and returns an access token plus user info.
evals.expected_output: Controller returns a unified ApiResponse envelope with data+meta, uses a LoginRequest DTO (not entity), and follows RESTful versioned URL.

evals.prompt: Define how my API should return validation errors and auth errors. I want a consistent error format so my Android app can handle them programmatically.
evals.expected_output: Structured error envelope with machine-readable string code, human message, optional details, plus requestId in meta; proper HTTP status mapping (400/401/404/500).

evals.prompt: Create a paginated endpoint for listing user diaries. GET /api/v1/diaries with page and pageSize params.
evals.expected_output: Pagination params (page/pageSize, camelCase, pageSize<=100), response with data array + meta containing page/pageSize/total.
